name: Willow Storage
description: Storage specialist. Luxury boutique: designer pieces, priced well above the market. We carry wardrobes, cabinets.
skill_description: We sell wardrobes, cabinets, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
